1|## Chapter 30 — The Emergency Powers Debate
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents accepted emergency rule to survive the storm. You debate whether to institutionalize the exceptions."*  
     4|*Chief Justice Lerna Patel V: "We're not just discussing powers. We're deciding what kind of state we want to be when afraid."*  
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a legislative pulse: Constitutional Review Committee - Emergency Powers Amendment Proposal. Chief Justice Lerna Patel V adjusted her spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent listening to the quiet arguments of justice, as she looked at the notification flashing across her console in the Valles Marineris Judicial Chamber's constitutional law office.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," she said, her voice carrying the rasp of years spent in law libraries and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this proposal."
